Jonathan Bama Jonathan Bama is Quick Stryke's younger brother. When the chance was given to him by Iron Klaw to become the Ultimate Soldier through an experimentation project he enthusiastically volunteered for it. Quick Stryke… Quick Stryke Quick Stryke was the G.I. Joe Extreme's resident former bad guy team member. He and his brother had joined S.K.A.R. in the early days of the organization. Steel Raven Steel Raven has earned the reputation of the "Most Dangerous Woman Alive", and she has earned it with blood and sweat. Joined S.K.A.R. at a very young age and quickly rose through their ranks, as a force to be reckoned…
